name: EditorialStoryPlanner
tagline: The newsroom story budget – pitch to publish, embargoes and legal checks in one app.
description: A complete newsroom planning app for Power Apps and Power Pages: daily story budget with KPIs, status lanes with drag-and-drop and workflow rules, a desk calendar of publish slots and embargo lifts, a searchable list with bulk moves and CSV export, story detail and a validated create/edit form. Works the moment it is dropped (demo mode) and connects to any collection, Dataverse/SharePoint table or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Bulk status moves with partial validation
Phone layout with lane picker and bottom bar
Demo mode with fictional newsroom data
